edges.reason: Birch sapling at (2,0,4) marks the path to the birch building; fence gate at (5,0,3) is on that path
Birch sapling guides player toward birch building where the door is the main entrance at (5,0,5)
Cyan wall banner is mounted inside the bedroom; player must enter and locate it before finding the bed below
Fence gate at (5,0,3) blocks the path leading to the birch door at (5,0,5); must clear gate first
Birch door blocks entry to the birch building interior where the crafting table is located at (6,0,7)
Crafting table at (6,0,7) is inside the birch building behind the birch door; door must be opened/mined
Tripwire hook is inside birch building near crafting table; finding it confirms player reached the crafting area
Glass pane in bedroom east wall overlooks the workshop area, helping player identify the ceiling build zone
Bowl crafting consumes 3 of 16 oak_planks; remaining 13 planks are then used for ceiling construction
Completing bedroom exploration (mining bed) frees player to move to the workshop area for ceiling building

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch sapling is at spawn-relative (2, 0, 4). Max_distance reduced to 8 to prevent accidental completion from spawn (player spawns ~4.5 blocks away but may not be facing it). 60° facing tolerance confirms visual identification of the sapling.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The tripwire hook is inside the birch building at spawn-relative (4, 1, 8), facing north and attached to the back wall at z=9. Max_distance 8 requires the player to enter the building to be close enough. 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the hook.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan wall banner is at spawn-relative (-6, 2, 4), mounted on the north interior wall of the bedroom (facing south, attached to stone_bricks at z=3). Max_distance 8 requires entering or being near the bedroom. Coordinates match the corrected scene command.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lime stained glass pane is at spawn-relative (-3, 2, 5), embedded in the east wall of the bedroom as a window. Max_distance 8 allows detection from inside the bedroom or from outside near the wall. 60° facing tolerance confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch fence gate drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The fence gate at (5, 0, 3) is the chokepoint entrance to the birch building path. It can be broken instantly by hand and drops 1 birch_fence_gate item.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch door drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The door at (5, 0-1, 5) blocks entry to the birch building interior where the crafting table is located. Breaking either half drops 1 birch_door item.

Uses inventory_has because mining an orange bed drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The bed at (-5, 0, 4-5) inside the bedroom can be broken instantly by hand. Breaking either the head or foot part drops 1 orange_bed item.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bowl places the result in the player's inventory. The player uses 3 of the 16 oak_planks (provided via /give) in a V-shape recipe at the crafting table at (6, 0, 7) inside the birch building. The bowl item appears in inventory upon successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bow places the result in the player's inventory. The player uses 3 sticks and 3 string (both provided via /give) at the crafting table. The bow item appears in inventory upon successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a ceiling means placing blocks overhead in the workshop area. The workshop has 4 oak_log pillars at corners (-2,-5), (2,-5), (-2,-2), (2,-2) rising to y=3. A ceiling should be placed at y=3 spanning between pillars. Checking for at least 9 oak_planks in a generous box (x=-3 to 3, y=3 to 4, z=-6 to -1) confirms meaningful ceiling construction. Player has 13 planks remaining after bowl crafting, making 9 blocks achievable.

task_text: Explore the birch village workshop: find the birch sapling, tripwire hook, cyan wall banner, and lime stained glass pane. Mine the birch fence gate, birch door, and orange bed. Use the crafting table inside the birch building to craft a bowl and a bow. Finally, build a ceiling over the open workshop area between the four pillars.
